name: security-patch
description: Kiro SDD security workflow: PoC attack reproduction, defense-in-depth AST guard implementation, and Strix autonomous penetration verification

steps.prompt: Scaffold security specification: `npm run spec:new -- --name {{inputs.name}} --domain {{inputs.domain}} --title "{{inputs.title}}" --type security`.
Document vulnerability vector, CVSS score, attack surface, and zero-trust invariants in brief.json. Run `npm run spec:build -- --name {{inputs.name}}`.
Wave 1: Construct safe PoC reproduction test demonstrating exploit vulnerability. Confirm test fails. Commit with [T1].
Wave 2: Implement defense-in-depth security controls (input validation, SQL AST guard, tenant isolation, rate limiting). Confirm PoC is blocked. Commit with [T2].
Wave 3: Run `npm run security:scan` and Strix autonomous penetration test. Verify 12 security red lines pass with 0 vulnerabilities.
